findings.summary: B1: explicit snapshot application requires a readable valid saved package.json before generic preflight. A deleted manifest fails ENOENT, a directory fails EISDIR, and edited invalid JSON fails manifest parsing. Both conflict modes stop with zero snapshot requests; overwrite cannot restore the payload, error cannot report /package.json, and an absent target cannot be added. Resolve application metadata from the verified incoming payload through the existing acquisition owner; saved-manifest readiness must remain a default-mode prerequisite only.
findings.authority: I8: generic paths/types/bytes conflict policy, absent targets added, overwrite replaces conflicting targets, no package-specific dependency interpretation; Acceptance 5 and 6 → I8; ADR-0394 decisions 4 and 5.
